sources.author: 稷山县文物保护中心公众号，摄影者未单独署名

source_note: 实拍为腰殿西壁上部三世佛，非大雄宝殿壁画。转绘选择三主尊、间列二弟子与两端小型胁侍，保持平面壁画布局；不代表全殿壁画，不作失色修复或考古复原。原照片裂隙与残损底色未仿制；线描的衣纹、面部与细部为风格化概括。腰殿1289建筑纪年与壁画最终绘制时间分开，采用运城博物馆介绍中援引孙博的元末至明初断代范围，并记录其他研究意见。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink uniformly gold in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: QINGLONG TEMPLE IN JISHAN COUNTY, SHANXI, UPPER PART OF THE WEST WALL MURAL IN YAODIAN HALL 青龙寺腰殿西壁三世佛壁画局部. Image2 is an authentic photograph of the flat mural, NOT statues. Draw precisely the SEVEN visible figures in this crop: THREE large seated Buddhas in a horizontal row with the CENTRAL Buddha slightly taller, two bald standing monk attendants between the seated Buddhas behind them, and one small standing attendant at each outer edge. Keep original flat frontal medieval mural composition, do NOT turn it into three-dimensional freestanding sculpture or Longmen cave. Preserve three large circular halos and two smaller attendant halos, each Buddha's distinct actual hand mudra: viewer-left Buddha right hand raised and left hand resting low, CENTRAL Buddha BOTH hands held at chest in the original gesture, viewer-right Buddha hands near lap. Preserve original folded legs and differentiated long flowing robe outlines, central white drapery, each distinct lotus throne and decorated pedestal only to the lower edge actually shown. Preserve sparse upper cloud and canopy contours that identify the original mural; do not draw a temple building or carve a cave around it. Keep the extent of this authentic crop as a fragment, omit undecipherable losses, do not invent bodies or repair missing portions. Remove photograph colour, cracks, shadows, surface stains, texture, superimposed marks and any writing. Hair and halos WHITE outlines, no dark hair fill. Very refined sparse pen contour drawing, ample open white areas within robes and background; just a few structural folds, no dense brocade, no crosshatching or areas of black. site_recommendation.name: 稷山青龙寺
site_recommendation.era: 元末—明初 · 腰殿壁画
site_recommendation.yearNote: 所绘为腰殿壁画，采用运城博物馆援引的孙博断代范围；1360仅为排序坐标。并非1289木构竣工年，壁画断代仍有不同研究意见。
site_recommendation.place: 山西稷山 · 稷峰镇马村
site_recommendation.lede: 马村青龙寺的腰殿把佛、道与世俗人物汇入一堂水陆画。西壁上部三世佛端坐云间，法衣与莲台的细线仍可辨认元明之际画工的手笔。

facts.label: 三教水陆
facts.text: 腰殿壁画以佛、道与儒家相关人物共同构成水陆道场，西壁上方三世佛与下方众神分层排列。

facts.label: 分清纪年
facts.text: 腰殿木构有1289年重建记录；壁画经历绘制、补绘，学者提出元末—明初等断代，不能全部套用木构年份。

facts.label: 局部转绘
facts.text: 本图以文保中心公开实拍转绘腰殿西壁上部，保留三世佛和胁侍组合，不代表全殿壁画或彩塑。
